## Goal

Apply the source document corrections the spec lists and cut the release tag. Run only after acceptance passes.

## Rules for this chunk (read first)

1. Build to `docs/spec.md` at git tag `spec-v1.1`. Do not edit `docs/spec.md`, `docs/rule-base.md`, `docs/ambiguity-log.md` or `docs/design.md`.
2. Implement only the requirements listed under "In scope". Do not add behavior the spec does not state, even if it seems obviously useful.
3. If a requirement is unclear, contradicts another, or needs a decision the spec does not make: do not decide it. Add an entry to `docs/build/spec-questions.md` (format below), skip that item, finish the rest, and list the question in the PR. Scott resolves it and, if needed, the spec gets a version bump.
4. Every automated test's name starts with the REQ IDs it verifies, for example `REQ-4-7 REQ-4-8: greeting times out after 5 s`.
5. Add `node scripts/trace.mjs --chunk C7 --strict` to the unit job in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, next to the earlier chunks' lines.
5a. Fill the "Verified by" column of `docs/build/traceability.md` for every in-scope row (test file and test name, or the manual check to perform). Set Status to `built` for automated rows that pass, or `needs Scott` for manual rows.
6. No secrets in the repo, logs, test output or PR. Passwords are entered by Scott with `wrangler secret put` only. Never print a secret value.
7. Work on branch `chunk/C7`. Open a pull request titled `C7: Source document corrections and release`. Do not merge it. Stop after opening the PR.
8. The PR description contains: in-scope REQs and their status, the exact commands you ran with their pass/fail results, anything deferred and why, and any spec questions raised.

Spec question format (append to `docs/build/spec-questions.md`):

```
## Q<n> (C7)
REQ: <id(s)>
Question: <what is unclear>
Options: <2 or 3 readings>
Blocking: <yes/no; what is skipped until answered>
Resolution:
```
